The name Glennis carries the meaning “Stream or valley” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Glennis usually hope their child will grow to embody stream or valley and live with faith, good character and purpose.
